actual_call.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create a square HIGH-IMPACT CHINESE ECOMMERCE AD ARTWORK with no text, based closely on the VISUAL LAYOUT of image5 R001, not a clean catalog/intro sheet. Inputs1 actual front,2 actual face/control closeup,3 actual side,4 gray curvature aid,5 R001 STYLE ONLY. APPEARANCE AUTHORITY: Actual SILVER product photographs govern every visible product feature. Mirror-bright SILVER curved shell/handle, true round head with an identifiable cylindrical sidewall, shallow back flowing continuously into the long gently curved neck and calmer lower handle. No flat racket, abrupt shoulder, inflated bulb or extreme goose-neck. Black textured teardrop front panel with dense separate ivory WHITE nozzle rings, each one clean ring/one dark opening, original spacing, no fused rings, tails or ghosts; concentric tiny DARK perimeter holes. Original small RED center descaling control is a low wide flange plus smaller raised concentric boss and dark center opening, no oversized torus or new black pedestal. Lower separate rounded-rectangle selector is shiny SILVER inside black insert. Complete single showerhead ends in short bare SILVER threaded stub: REMOVE photographed hand, hose and quick-release connector; keep real handle. Clean polished photographic highlights, not matte CG steel. Do not introduce hands/people, water, spray, hose, mount, accessories, filters, internal machinery, certificates, logos, brand, text, numerals or claims. All graphic bars/capsules below must remain entirely EMPTY; typography will be composited later. Actual photo appearance overrides model/style product. Gray model is only broad side-curvature aid.
STYLE/COMPOSITION: Rebuild R001's dramatic diagonal shallow rectangular display TRAY, rich chocolate-brown perimeter, bright champagne-gold tray floor, gold trim and large angular perspective corners. The tray fills most of the image at a diagonal, shown from above in shallow 3/4 perspective with strong product-to-tray shadow. Place ONLY ONE actual SILVER showerhead diagonally ON the tray: bare threaded end at lower-left around(300,950), head at upper-right around(850,330) on a1254square; face visible and glossy cylindrical edge readable. Hero product large and complete ABOVE the bottom title bar, dominates the photograph; preserve full handle length/head ratio, do not stand it upright or place it on rocks. Remove the reference's hose/mount, brand, thumbs-up hand, giveaway icons and every word. Warm gold illumination and deep brown shadows, dense product ad rhythm. A SMALL detail window at lower-right around x950..1200,y750..1000 shows a photographic crop of the actual lower SILVER selector/black insert, not another complete product; thin gold edge and subtle shadow. One EMPTY gold/brown rounded capsule near upper-left x40..360,y100..180 for a short later claim. Minimal empty background outside these intentional text zones.
MANDATORY BOTTOM GRAPHIC: reserve entire bottom18% (y1030..1254) as a solid two-color coarse-title banner: left roughly35% pale metallic GOLD panel, right65% deep chocolate BROWN panel. Strong bold retail graphic feel, clean straight horizontal edge, subtle trim/shadow, NO WORDS. Product and inset remain above banner. This is a high-density ecommerce ad with giant product, diagonal tray, one detail inset and hard title strip, not a luxury sparse still-life or instruction card.
